title: Utah Tech Intermediate — IM Reverse Order
text:
Warm-up:
200 choice

Main Set:
4x100 IM reverse order @2:00 (Free, Breast, Back, Fly) :30 rest
4x50 Fly @1:00
4x50 Back @:55
4x50 Breast @1:00
2x100 IM @1:45

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: Utah Tech University Human Performance Center
coach_notes: Intermediate-level IM workout. Reverse IM order challenges swimmers to think about transitions. ~1600 yards.

title: Utah Tech Intermediate — Freestyle Build
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice

Main Set:
2x500 Free (first: build by 100, second: negative split)
200 kick choice
4x100 Free @1:30 descend 1-4

Cool-down:
200 easy
source_name: Utah Tech University Human Performance Center
coach_notes: Freestyle endurance set focused on pacing and building effort. Good for learning to negative split. ~1800 yards.

title: Utah Tech Intermediate — Turns and Streamlines
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice

Main Set:
4x50 kick @1:00 (focus on streamline off each wall)
200 Free (count strokes per length)
4x50 Free @:55 (sprint off walls, easy mid-pool)
200 Free (match stroke count from earlier)
4x50 kick sprint @1:00

Cool-down:
100 easy back
source_name: Utah Tech University Human Performance Center
coach_notes: Technique workout emphasizing turns, streamlines, and stroke efficiency. ~1700 yards.

title: Utah Tech Intermediate — IM Transitions
text:
Warm-up:
200 choice

Main Set:
4x200 IM @3:30 (focus on transitions between strokes)
8x25 sprint @:30 (alternate Fly and Back)
4x100 Free @1:30
8x25 sprint @:30 (alternate Breast and Free)

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: Utah Tech University Human Performance Center
coach_notes: IM transition work — the 25 sprints isolate the turn/transition between each IM stroke. ~1800 yards.

title: SwimMAC Carolina — Wetland Underwater Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
200 kick

Main Set:
4x50 IM order fast @1:15
8x100 Back @3:00 (25 squats between, focus on underwaters)
4x50 choice fast @1:15
6x100 Breast @3:00 (10 squats between, underwater pullouts)
4x50 IM order fast @1:15
4x100 Fly @3:00 (15 squats between, max underwaters)
4x50 choice fast @1:15
2x100 Free @3:00 (15 squats between, breakout speed)
4x50 IM order fast @1:15

Cool-down:
200 easy
source_name: SwimMAC Carolina — Coach Emily Laurent (Swimming Wizard)
coach_notes: Underwater technique under stress. 11-14 age group (BB-Age Group cut). Dryland between swim sets creates fatigue for underwater work. ~3800 yards.

title: 200 IM Predictor Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free
200 kick choice
4x50 drill @1:00

Main Set:
10x50 @1:00 as:
  1x50 Dive Fly — best effort
  2x50 Back (1 cruise, 1 best effort)
  3x50 Breast (2 cruise, 1 best effort)
  :30 rest
  4x50 Free — best possible average

4x100 IM @1:45 (apply predictor pacing)

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: Swimming Wizard — Coach Ben Seamer, Australia
coach_notes: Predictor set: best effort form strokes + best Free average predicts 200 IM time within 3 seconds. Age group level. ~1900 yards.

title: Pre-Championship Tune-Up
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
4x50 kick @1:00 (alternate fast/easy)
4x25 IM order @:40

Main Set:
4x200 Free (vary fast sections: first 50 fast, last 50 fast, middle 100 fast, all out)
4x100 Free with fins (vary fast sections same pattern)
8x50 choice @:45 (race pace)

Cool-down:
300 easy (100 back, 100 breast, 100 free)
source_name: Swimming Wizard — Coach Mike Cook, Mason Makos
coach_notes: Pre-championship speed work for 11-14 year olds preparing for JOs. Varying fast sections teach race strategy. ~2900 yards.

title: College Sprint Day — IM Focus
text:
Warm-up:
600 (200 Free, 200 IM, 200 choice)

Main Set:
Round 1 (100s):
1x100 Fly race pace @1:10
50 easy (drill/swim)
1x100 Back race pace @1:10
50 easy
1x100 Breast race pace @1:20
50 easy
1x100 Free race pace @1:05
50 easy

Round 2 (75s):
1x75 Fly @:55
50 easy
1x75 Back @:55
50 easy
1x75 Breast @1:05
50 easy
1x75 Free @:50
50 easy

Round 3 (50s):
4x50 IM order @:40 (all race pace)

Cool-down:
400 easy pull
source_name: Swimming Wizard — Coach Shawn Anderson, Swim Streamline
coach_notes: Descending distance IM sprint day. Each round gets shorter and faster. Develops IM race speed across all four strokes. ~2800 yards.

title: Collegiate Threshold Freestyle
text:
Warm-up:
800 (200 Free, 200 kick, 200 pull, 200 IM)

Pre-set:
8x50 Free @:50 (descend 1-4, 5-8)

Main Set:
3x400 Free @5:00 (hold threshold pace)
200 easy
6x200 Free @2:45 (negative split each)
200 easy
12x100 Free @1:20 (descend 1-4, repeat)

Cool-down:
400 easy (200 back, 200 choice)
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — collegiate level
coach_notes: High-volume threshold set for college swimmers. Descending pattern from 400s to 100s while maintaining pace discipline. ~5600 yards.

title: Collegiate Distance Day
text:
Warm-up:
800 (400 swim, 200 kick, 200 drill)

Main Set:
1x1000 Free @13:00 moderate
200 easy
2x500 Free @6:30 (build each 500)
200 easy
5x200 Free @2:40 (descend 1-5)
200 easy
10x100 Free @1:15 (odds moderate, evens fast)

Cool-down:
400 easy pull
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — collegiate level
coach_notes: Classic distance training day with descending distances and increasing intensity. Builds aerobic base and pacing. ~5800 yards.

title: College Backstroke Specialist
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free
200 Back drill (single arm, spin, catch-up)
4x50 Back kick @1:00

Main Set:
8x75 Back @1:15 (25 drill, 25 build, 25 fast)
200 easy Free
6x100 Back @1:30 (descend 1-3, 4-6)
200 easy Free
8x50 Back @:45 (odds fast, evens easy)
200 easy Free
4x25 Back sprint @:30

Cool-down:
300 easy (100 breast, 200 free)
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — collegiate level
coach_notes: Backstroke-specific workout with drill integration. Progressive intensity across the session. ~3400 yards.

title: College Breaststroke and Kick Day
text:
Warm-up:
400 choice
4x100 IM @1:45

Main Set:
8x50 Breast kick @1:00 (streamline, no board)
4x100 Breast @1:40 (25 drill, 75 swim)
200 easy Free
8x50 Breast @:55 (descend 1-4, 5-8)
4x100 Breast @1:35 (build each 100)
200 easy Free
8x25 Breast sprint @:30

Cool-down:
300 easy back/free
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — collegiate level
coach_notes: Breaststroke specialist day. Heavy kick emphasis early, transitions to full-stroke speed work. ~3500 yards.

title: College Butterfly Power Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free
200 Fly drill (one-arm, 3-3-3, rhythm drill)
4x50 Fly kick on back @1:00

Main Set:
6x75 Fly @1:20 (25 drill, 50 swim)
200 easy Free
4x100 (75 Fly + 25 Free) @1:30
200 easy Free
8x50 Fly @:55 (odds build, evens fast)
200 easy Free
8x25 Fly sprint @:40

Cool-down:
400 easy (200 back, 200 free)
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — collegiate level
coach_notes: Butterfly specialist set. Short rest forces stroke efficiency. Free breaks prevent technique breakdown from fatigue. ~3250 yards.

title: Age Group 11-12 Technique Day
text:
Warm-up:
200 Free
100 kick choice
100 drill choice

Main Set:
4x50 Fly @1:15 (25 drill, 25 swim)
4x50 Back @1:10 (25 drill, 25 swim)
4x50 Breast @1:15 (25 drill, 25 swim)
4x50 Free @1:00 (25 drill, 25 swim)
4x100 IM @2:00 (focus on transitions)

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — age group level
coach_notes: Technique-focused practice for 11-12 year olds. Drill/swim pattern for every stroke. IM finisher reinforces transitions. ~2000 yards.

title: Age Group Sprint Development
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice
4x50 kick @1:00

Main Set:
8x25 Free sprint @:30 (from dive or push)
200 easy
8x25 choice sprint @:35 (non-free stroke)
200 easy
4x50 Free sprint @:55
200 easy
4x50 choice sprint @1:00
100 easy
2x100 Free all-out @2:00

Cool-down:
300 easy back/free
source_name: Compiled from standard coaching patterns — age group level
coach_notes: Sprint development for age group swimmers. Short distances with full rest. Progressive from 25s to 100s. ~2500 yards.

title: D3 Multisport Triathlon Swim
text:
Warm-up:
300 Free easy
4x50 drill @1:00 (catch-up, fingertip drag, fist, swim)

Main Set:
4x200 Free @3:00 (build each 200)
4x100 Free @1:40 (descend 1-4)
4x50 Free @:50 (all fast)
200 easy
2x400 Free @6:00 (negative split each)

Cool-down:
200 easy back
coach_notes: Triathlon-focused freestyle workout. Emphasis on pacing and negative splitting for open water racing. ~3100 yards.

title: Gwen Jorgensen Level 3 — IM Progression
text:
Warm-up:
200 Free

Pre-set:
2x200 IM @3:30 (or 200 Free/Back alternating)
2x150 (50 drill, 100 build) @2:30

Main Set:
3x100 Free descend @1:30
4x50 drill with breathing progression @1:00 (breathe every 3, 5, 7, 3 by 50)

Repeat Pre-set and Main Set

Cool-down:
200 easy choice
source_name: Gwen Jorgensen / Colleen Quigley Swim Workouts
coach_notes: Structured intermediate workout with IM warm-up, drill integration, and breathing work. Two-cycle pattern. ~2400 yards.
